event_detail: Kettle: the gripper moves around above the kettle on the counter with its fingers closed on nothing, comes somewhat closer at 24.0 s, then drifts back over the right side of the stove at 25.6 s without grasping it.
evidence: The kettle stays on the counter to the right of the stove in every frame. Zooming on the wrist camera's finger pads shows them closed together (empty) in all four frames, so the gripper cannot be grasping the kettle; the wrist view goes from high above the kettle, to closer, to over the stove with the kettle off to the right. No burner is lit. It may be repositioning for a new attempt, so confidence is low.
